## Checklist

- [ ] Works in a home with no matching sensors (the empty-house tests pass)
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] README / `docs/` and CHANGELOG ("Unreleased") updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] New strings added to `strings.json` and every `translations/*.json`
- [ ] AI tools were used for this change (disclosed above), or none were used
